dedupe_keys.name: floodwatch ph open source observed flood extent and recurrence mapping from satellite data

description: Xavier Puspus publishes FloodWatch.PH, a Python workflow for observed flood-extent and recurrence mapping in the Philippines. Zenodo archives version 1.5.3 under MIT; the linked repository also distinguishes MIT code from CC BY 4.0 data. One track detects changed water extent in Sentinel-1 SAR scenes and exports event GeoJSON. A second track fits a calibrated logistic head to public satellite embeddings and historical flood events for recurrence-proneness mapping. Outputs can help compare mapped exposure of roads, buildings and flood-control works with past observed inundation. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this workflow. A limitation is that recurrence-proneness scores are modelled classifications, not flood-depth forecasts or approved engineering hazard maps. The source claims validation on a named 2015 event, which was not independently reproduced. No archive was downloaded or code executed.
